entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-07-16
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • `dotnet run file.cs` should not pick up implicit build files by default #49826
  • SdkResolver may need to set DOTNET_ROOT in order for framework-dependent processes inside an IDE to run correctly #49825
  • `dotnet run file.cs` `#:` directive for `ItemGroup` #49820
  • Directive error message brevity #49817
  • Show error when using invalid `global.json` version string like `9.0.x` #49816
  • Improve experience In dnx/dotnet tool exec when there are no non-preview tool packages available #49815
  • Allow `dotnet format` to be applied to arbitrary files #49812
  • Fiddler (local HTTPS MITM) no longer seeks .NET SDK traffic, .NET SDK rejects certificate #49811
  • Improve skipped test output #49805
  • .NET 10 preview 6 SDK did not generate exe/AppHost when pack as tool #49799
  • dotnet app.cs #:sdk directive pinned version results in The SDK 'Sdk/Version' specified could not be found. #49797
    10.0.1xx

Closed

  • `Microsoft.DotNet.Cli.Utils.csproj` is built twice causing PDB mismatch on some platforms #44033
  • Using .cs files like .py files #28014
  • EnableWindowsTargeting is broken in .NET 10 Preview 4 (Microsoft.WindowsDesktop.App.Ref not found) #48949
  • API Diff summary markdown ends with 2 blank lines instead of 1 #49793
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `sdk/release/9.0.3xx` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #49782
  • DOTNET_EXPERIMENTAL_HOST_PATH set incorrectly with SDK hint paths #49363
  • dnx missing on macOS in Preview 6 #49804
  • Certificate trust list needs to be backported to 6.0.3xx (and maybe 6.0.1xx) #33928
    Discussion

PullRequests

Created

  • Limit the expected search location for the dotnet muxer from the sdk resolver result #49824
  • Add .NET 6.0 to EOL frameworks list #49823
    Branch Lockdown
  • [release/9.0.1xx] Add .NET 6.0 to End-of-Life frameworks list to generate NETSDK1138 warnings #49822
    Branch Lockdown
  • Don't put testing global.json in artifacts dir directly #49819
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Fix tool projects so they don't remove apphosts when publishing (not packing) #49818
  • set env var to rollback revocation check change in .NET 10 previews #49814
  • Implementing dotnet pack with nuspec files #49813
  • Fix typo. #49810
    Area-AspNetCore
  • Allow skipping project fallback with file-based run #49808
    Area-run-file
  • Handle versioned `#:sdk` being first #49807
    Area-run-file
  • Show skip/fail reason in dotnet test #49806
  • [wasm] General HotReload agent for WebAssembly in browser #49800
    Area-AspNetCore, 10.0.1xx

Merged

  • Re-add Version.Details.xml props for win* repos. #49821
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Prevent double-building of Microsoft.DotNet.Cli.Utils.csproj by excluding PublishDir from global properties #49090
  • Cleanup PipeNameDescription #49756
  • Remove extra newline from APIDiff TOC #49794
  • Normalize shim output directory in publish scenario #49801
  • make SdkResolver try to locate the dotnet host closest to the resolved SDK #49772
    Area-SdkResolvers, Area-NetSDK, Area-MSBuild
  • ensure that Content items are available during restore to un-break Razor #49783

Updated

  • Add support for flat launch settings #49769
    Area-run-file
  • Various SDK build fixes within VS #49748
  • Implement support for changing project and package references #49611
    Area-AspNetCore
  • Add flag and tests for codesigning single-file bundles targeting MacOS #49697
  • Add support for CsWinRT 3.0 multi-targeting via Windows SDK build number #49721
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Fix Microsoft.IO.Redist versions #48819
    Area-CodeFlow
  • Update the minimum msbuild version for .NET 10 #49531
  • Fix --no-build flag error message inconsistency for non-existent project files #49544
  • Fix dotnet new "Add project to solution" postAction to find .slnx files #49541
  • Implement `#:package` manipulation for file-based apps #49635
    Area-run-file
  • Fix GenAPI to capture parameter attributes #49795
  • Override default properties with custom file-level directives #49767
    Area-run-file
  • Adjust `IsTestProject` hacks to not include MTP #49085
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #49740
    Area-CodeFlow, Area-VMR
  • Update xlf copilot instructions #49780
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Automatically cleanup old artifacts of file-based apps #49666
    Area-run-file
  • Re-enable DotNet.Watcher.Tests #49642
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/9.0.3xx' => 'main' #49389
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/9.0.1xx' => 'release/9.0.3xx' #49715
    Branch Lockdown
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/8.0.4xx' => 'release/9.0.1xx' #49724
    Area-Containers, Branch Lockdown
  • Minimal work to make System.Diagnostics.Activity usable by the dotnet CLI application and codebase #49749

  • Use IConfigurationBuilder, IConfiguration, and Typed Configuration to centralize the way we manage CLI behaviors #49761
    Area-CLI, config-system-candidate
